'''Yuri Shiratori''' (Japanese: '''白鳥由里''' ''Shiratori Yuri'') is a Japanese voice actress of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

== Pokémon roles ==
Shiratori began to provide voices for Pokémon starting in {{aniseries|OS}}. She gained a few more roles until the end of {{aniseries|RS}}.
